threshold.value: With respect to Party A: zero if a Collateral Event or Required Ratings Downgrade Event has occurred and is continuing, otherwise infinity. With respect to Party B: infinity.
threshold.evidence_quote:
“Threshold” means with respect to Party A and any Valuation Date, zero if (i) a Collateral Event has occurred and has been continuing (x) for at
least 30 days or (y) since this Annex was executed, or (ii) a Required Ratings Downgrade Event has occurred and is continuing, otherwise, infinity.
 
“Threshold” means with respect to Party B and any Valuation Date, infinity.

minimum_transfer_amount.value: USD 100,000 (or USD 50,000 if certain conditions are met)
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote:
“Minimum Transfer Amount” means USD 100,000 with respect to Party A and Party B; provided, however, that if the aggregate Certificate Principal Balance and note principal
balance of Certificates and Notes rated by S&P ceases to be more than USD 50,000,000, the “Minimum Transfer Amount” shall be USD 50,000.

rounding.value: Delivery Amount rounded up to nearest USD 10,000; Return Amount rounded down to nearest USD 10,000
rounding.evidence_quote:
Rounding. The Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000. The Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of USD
10,000.

valuation_percentage.value: The Valuation Percentage equals the percentage specified under the applicable Rating Agency's column in the table (e.g., 100% for US-CASH under S&P/Fitch, Moody's First Trigger, and Moody's Second Trigger); if rated by more than one Rating Agency, the lowest applicable percentage applies.
valuation_percentage.evidence_quote:
The Valuation Percentage shall equal the percentage specified under such Rating Agency’s name above. If Party A is rated by more than one Rating Agency specified above, the
Valuation Percentage shall equal the lowest of the applicable percentages specified above.
